scope: Targeted review of user-moved VBUS divider R103/R105/R106, its U602/C108/U4 signal path, J502 adjacency and three reassigned preliminary copper fragments. No source files modified.
decision: Keep the user positions and rotations of all three VBUS resistors. No VBUS placement delta or copper deletion proposed.
evidence: baseline_refilled/drc.json native KiCad DRC after project-aware fill

native_refilled_validation.note: Whole-board counts reflect an incomplete routed board; this is a targeted placement review, not fabrication approval.

placement.finding: The divider is compact and clear of same-face pads and courtyards. R103 VM pad points outward/right toward power copper; R105 and R106 leave their common divider node close together.

R106 pad 2 to U602 pin 13 straight-line distance increases from 2.025 mm to 4.801 mm. This remains a short local interconnect and creates more room around the mux support network; there is no reason to undo the user placement merely to recover this distance.
C108 stays at the MCU: its VBUS_SENSE pad is 1.230 mm center-to-center from U4 PC0/pad 9 and already has a short F.Cu trace. Keep C108 here.
J502 is front-side SMD and the VBUS resistors are on the back; native DRC finds no local short, clearance or courtyard clash. No through-hole conflict introduced.

signal_path: R103 pad 2 → R105 28k pad 1 and R106 1k pad 1
U602 pin 12 (VBUS_SENSE) → C108 pad 1 and U4 PC0/pad 9
routing_remaining: Complete the R103/R105/R106 common node with short 6 mil signal tracks; both connections remain unrouted.
Route R106 pad 2 leftward to U602 pins 13/14 as a compact local branch; the existing diagonal VBUS_MUX_IN fragment is disconnected and does not complete it.
Route U602 pin 12 to the existing C108/U4 VBUS_SENSE segment through a quiet corridor with continuous ground reference; avoid phase/switch-node copper and gate loops.
Connect R105 and C108 grounds to the local ground reference; native DRC still lists both returns unconnected.
Connect the R103 VM pad to the intended bus-sense source while retaining Power-class clearance. Placement does not complete the high-voltage tap.

user_copper_delta.removed_description: Three old GLS3 fragments and one GND fragment were removed outside the board; preserve these user removals.
user_copper_delta.three_remaining_fragments: Former HS_RETURN_W/GHS3/GLS3 stubs are now labelled GND/GND/VBUS_MUX_IN without a geometric change. All three are dangling, not accidentally touching moved component pads, and have no native clearance/short violations. Retain in this placement pass; they can be pruned or replaced during routing.
user_copper_delta.closest_to_any_vbus_pad: The VBUS_MUX_IN stub ends 0.432 mm from R103 pad 2 and 0.708 mm from R106 pad 2; it is electrically separate.

limits: No full analog sampling or ADC settling qualification performed in this placement-only review.
Mechanical assembly clearance beyond native two-sided PCB courtyard rules was not modeled.
